name: 1X EVE
summary: EVE is 1X Technologies' earlier wheeled humanoid with a self-balancing base, two arms and simple grippers, aimed at security, logistics and facility work. 1X listed it at 6 ft 2 in and 192 lb with a 9 mph top speed and up to 6 hours of runtime. It runs in a shared-autonomy mode where a remote operator can take control.
sensors: HDR cameras: two front and one rear.
compute: Intel i7 for real-time control, Nvidia Xavier for AI inference (per robotsguide.com).
highlights: Self-balancing two-wheeled base; can go down stairs but not up them.
Shared autonomy: an operator can take over remotely.
caveats: 1X now focuses on NEO; current EVE availability is unclear and the specs come from an older 1X site.
Announcement date not confirmed from a primary source.
